sample_unit: ChatGPT-generated clinical vignettes with queries and answers

links.outcome: Accuracy and validity of citations and source URLs provided by ChatGPT
links.effect: The model could not give accurate citations initially. It gave URLs on the fifth attempt, but most failed to open the relevant pages.
links.quote: When asked about citations to information sources, the model could not provide accurate citations initially and provided URL (Uniform Resource Locator) on the fifth attempt but most of them failed to open the relevant pages on their respective websites.

links.outcome: Accuracy of cervical cancer screening answers compared with current standard of care
links.effect: Of 5 vignettes, 1 answer was unsatisfactory, 2 were acceptable and 2 were satisfactory against the current standard of care.
links.quote: The answer was found to be unsatisfactory for one vignette, acceptable for two, and satisfactory for two when compared with the current standard of care.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy in generating and answering cervical cancer screening clinical vignettes without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
